g.text: Round 13 | Coefficients use only matured, pre-cutoff rolling labels
Calibration counts: 118 / 145 / 144 weeks. All three coefficients are frozen before outer evaluation.
Alpha = 0 uses the causal training mean; alpha = 1 keeps the original forecast. Leave-year variants are never deployed.
